descriptionMarkdown:
This is Orion

Version 2.1:
- fixed few bugs in transport belts
- added 2 more laser towers for better ammo handling
- adjusted tower positioning to optimize asteroid collecting
- added more batteries to support laser towers
- adjusted design for smoother look
- added planet routes with ammo conditions to platform hub to prevent stuck on the Aquilo
- adjusted indicators to show low values correctly

Important: 

If you have any issues to start the ship, set the condition on the CONTROL PANEL to "OR" temporary.

Also, i STRONGLY suggest you to set in your platform hub regular trips on Vulcanus for metallic asteroids and set condition for replenish ammo/rockets there. Otherwise you can stuck on Aquilo without ammo,metal and without any way how to create ammo and to fight through the big asteroids, which is VERY unpleasant situation! Bear in mind that on Aquilo are metallic asteroids almost non existent, so you have to mine them elsewhere, there's no other way.

If you have problem with room (cargo), i suggest to replace cargo with higher quality and you'll be OK.

Starship properties:
Size: 70(w)x129(h)
Weight: 979t
Cargo: 10x
Thrusters: 5x
Tanks: 50K
Energy: ~35MW/585MJ
Turrets: 16x gun,8x laser,10x rocket->34 total

This ship is suitable for your first trip on Aquilo. It can deal with large asteroids and it handles trips between all planets.
It uses nuclear power and it manufactures own nuclear fuel!
It's self sustain and prevents any overloads of collectors.
Ship contains control panel where engines efficiency can be set.
Ship contains indicator system for levels of energy,fluids and ammo.
Ship contains blinking navigation lights.

© Designed by Velda
https://www.youtube.com/@VeldaGames/

My other ships:

Destiny:

https://factorioprints.com/view/-P3cRqFRICyZFkZUFVrz

Aurora:

https://factorioprints.com/view/-P4L5RqArOGPQiRcSyxW

This ship has advanced asteroid crushing so be sure you researched advanced asteroid processing.

Ship was calibrated and tested on trips to Aquilo. With default control panel setup (115) ship reaches 60% fuel consumption and 85% efficiency. You can set it as you want but this is default value as the best compromise between speed and fuel consumption.

Ship has got implemented kovarex enrichment process, so you don’t need to worry about refueling and energy for a very long time (indicator of uran supplies is also included). However, you will need to provide the ship with some uran 235 and 238 from the planet at the beginning and also build some solar panels to start the process of creating uran on the ship.
